description: The figure contains two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa values as a function of ambiguity-related category levels, with the left panel relating Kappa to “Ambiguity Std” and the right panel relating Kappa to “Max Ambiguity.” In both panels, the horizontal axis contains the category values (left: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94; right: 1, 2, 3) shown in increasing order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale with tick marks from 0.0 to 0.8 at regular 0.2 intervals (bars extend slightly above 0.8 in both panels). In the left chart, four single bars are shown in progressively lighter blue shades from left to right, with value labels above each bar: Ambiguity Std 0.0 has a dark teal bar at approximately 0.88, 0.47 has a medium blue bar at approximately 0.46, 0.82 has a light blue bar at approximately 0.03, and 0.94 has a lighter blue bar at approximately 0.24. In the right chart, three single bars are shown (also in blue shades), with value labels above each bar: Max Ambiguity 1 has a dark teal bar at approximately 0.89, 2 has a medium blue bar at approximately 0.46, and 3 has a lighter blue bar at approximately 0.23. There is no legend, no stacking or grouping within categories beyond the two separate panels, and no additional visual emphasis beyond the numeric annotations placed above each bar.
